name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. The thicker ring stands out better on busy backgrounds while still meeting WCAG’s 7:1 minimum for interactive elements. Sharp edges keep the focus indicator crisp and predictable, avoiding the distraction of blur or glow. Trade-off: the thicker ring takes slightly more space, but that’s a worthwhile cost for clarity and reliability across devices.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on mobile/touch: fingers cover thin rings, and 7:1 contrast can vanish in bright sunlight. Use a 4px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px inner glow—thicker for visibility under fingers, lower contrast for reduced glare, and glow for outdoor readability. Test with a 1000-nit display outdoors to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 4px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a subtle 1px inner glow. The thicker ring survives finger smudges and bright glare, while the lower contrast and glow prevent eye strain outdoors. Trade-off: we accept slightly less crisp edges and a minor WCAG contrast hit to keep the indicator usable in real-world conditions.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-5118, worker-1279 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with glow risks failing users who need high contrast due to low vision—WCAG 2.2 AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text, but interactive elements must meet 3:1. Test with a screen reader user in bright outdoor light and a high-contrast mode user; if either fails to identify focus, revert to a 3px ring at 7:1 with no glow.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 4px solid #005fcc focus ring at 8:1 contrast with no glow—deliver as a tested, documented style token in the design system; owner: Ramp.
